desc: GTCEu mod check (no mission): tungstate ore needs an IRON pickaxe. Places gtceu:tungstate_ore, kits a stone and an iron pickaxe, and asks the game's own harvest predicate (Player.hasCorrectToolForDrops, the call Forge makes on a block break to decide the drops) with each one in hand. PASS = the block is there, it requires the correct tool, the stone pickaxe would get no drop, the iron pickaxe would. Known-bad twin: gtceu-ore-harvest-tier-knownbad.

checks.desc: the placed block is GTCEu tungstate ore
it drops only for the correct tool
a stone pickaxe in hand gets no drop
checks.jeval: (function () { Player.openInventory().setSelectedHotbarSlotIndex(0); var p = Player.getPlayer(); var state = World.getBlock(0, 101, 2).getBlockStateHelper().getRaw(); return { held: p.getMainHand().getItemId(), drops: p.getRaw()[srg('Player', 'hasCorrectToolForDrops')](state) }; })()

checks.desc: an iron pickaxe in hand gets the drop
checks.jeval: (function () { Player.openInventory().setSelectedHotbarSlotIndex(1); var p = Player.getPlayer(); var state = World.getBlock(0, 101, 2).getBlockStateHelper().getRaw(); return { held: p.getMainHand().getItemId(), drops: p.getRaw()[srg('Player', 'hasCorrectToolForDrops')](state) }; })()
